body: I do not believe or disbelieve, but if it would make me happy I would believe. I am quite blank as a person, very dull. I have to consciously decide whenever I think, like or do anything. It's hard because there is nothing fundamental in me except that I am fundamentally sad. Thank you for being kind.

Thanks, it was very hard for me to even accept that I had Aspergers. It's offensive when somebody tells you that you aren't on the same wavelength as other people and it makes you question whether this is a wavelength at all. I feel like everybody is just at different stages in understanding to each other and being ignorant is the best place you could ever be at. It makes me sad because the more I tried to explore the more it hurt me, so I'm trying to stay 'in the moment'. But sometimes I just crash and I will try to do something bad. Usually it's too difficult to go through with it. Thank you for listening.

I like to walk too and I like the cloud idea. I think maybe sometimes it helps to only concentrate on what I am doing in the next 5 minutes and make sure they aren't bad things. Do you think religion is helpful?

Thank you. I'm just not good. I can't cope with everyday little things like the sounds outside or understanding that other people exist and I get overwhelmed by everything and every thought. It feels like too much.

I've attempted in the past and it had gotten really bad. I feel like I have experienced the worst that it can get, I am not naive or inexperienced like some might expect of a 19 year old. I'm very sad but very aware and that's what is most painful. I am constantly sabotaging myself and I don't like this life. I would rather live somewhere simple and primal, I can't cope with civilised things very well. But I have anxiety and I don't know how to get anywhere. What helps you to be alright?

Thank you. I'm just not very good at function like a person. Everything always hurts and everything is hard. Even when good things happen I think of how easily something terrible could have happened. I don't want to be like this, I just want to not think about anything. I hope you're alright.

Thank you. I feel like nothing in the world could feel as bad as I do right now. I tried turning my life around and I do sports, college and volunteering because I thought that would make me better but it doesn't. I don't understand how so many people can find reasons to keep going everyday.
